title: [SOLVED-ish] Latest update lags my computer...
body: don't know what was in the recent update, but when I rebooted, everything is laggy. Loading, type, shutting down. Switching between mouse and keyboard, I get a double character for the first keypress after using the mouse. I want to switch to a different system, but was going to backup what I could before. I wanted to switch to the last update I did yesterday, because my computer wasn't lagging before. Followed this: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Arch_L … cific_date $ sudo pacman -Syyuu :: Synchronizing package databases... core 127.5 KiB 213 KiB/s 00:01 [######################] 100% :: Starting full system upgrade... there is nothing to do This was added to `/etc/pacman.conf` Server = https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/09/11/$repo/os/$arch How to get my computer back to the way it was? Last edited by NeoGeo (2026-09-13 16:52:51)
